checks_run.procedure: Judge F-DG5-120 adversarially. Re-read the round-2 screenshots of this candidate (en and ar). In the clone, inspect every use of elementLabel, the 0062 seed, the scoring-defaults editor's labels, the transformation-facing weight-set, scorecard and ranking labels, and whether any server scoring, ranking, gate or publish logic reads the label attributes. checks_run.expected: Accept as an observation only if the defect is confined to presentation, has no data, calculation, authorization or approval effect, breaks no DG5 acceptance text, and can safely move to DG6. Otherwise keep it open.
checks_run.actual: The defect is confirmed: on the English page the Studio Elements table shows the Arabic labels of the five scoring weights, because 0062 seeds sourceLabelEn + labelAr without labelEn and elementLabel() falls back to labelAr. Its reach is limited. elementLabel is used only in studio/ElementsSection.tsx, the admin table. The editor uses i18n studio.criterion.*. WeightSets, Scorecard and Rankings use prioritization.criterion.<code>, and screens/en/dom-p3-after-prioritization.png (round 2, this candidate) shows English 'Strategic fit: 30% ... Time-to-value: 15%'. No server scoring, ranking, gate-facts or publish code reads these label attributes (grep exit 1 = no match, which is the expected result, not a failure). The stable key and B0076 are shown beside each label, and the Arabic page is correct. No REQ-PB-093 clause concerns this label, and its A06/A07 clauses passed in my round 2 (DOM-R2-08). Verdict: ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION (Low, non-mandatory). DG6 follow-up: English fallback to sourceLabelEn or a labelEn seed in a new migration, plus a component test. A minor cosmetic item noted for the same follow-up: studio.criterion.time_to_value reads 'Time to value', while B0076 and prioritization.json read 'Time-to-value'.
